title: exam-day
prompt:
Mobile screen (iPhone, 393pt wide, dark mode) for "NY RE Exam": the "Exam day guide" screen. Design concept "Wayfinding": the visual language of New York subway signage. Every syllabus topic is a colored circular route bullet with one bold character (red #DA291C "1"/"2", blue #0039A6 "A"/"C", green #00843D "4"/"6", orange #FF6319 "B"/"D", yellow #FCCC0A with dark text "N"/"R", purple #9B2A92 "7", lime #6CBE45 "G"); progress is drawn as a line with station dots. Everything else is quiet, native-iOS polish on a dark OLED canvas.
Typography: Helvetica Neue bold for headings and all numbers (tabular figures, tight -0.02em tracking), system UI for body text. Sentence case everywhere. No all-caps labels, no middle-dot separators, no arrows on buttons, no emoji.
Palette: canvas #090d16, surface #111725, raised #182033, hairline rgba(148,163,184,.16), ink #f1f5f9, secondary ink #a3b1c6, go #10b981, stop #ef4444, caution #f59e0b, statute indigo #818cf8. Elevation by surface lightness, not shadows. Radius: 24 hero, 18 cards, 14 controls, full pills for bullets. Every tap target at least 44pt. Floating glass capsule tab bar at the bottom with 6 tabs (icon over label): Home, Study, Build, Stats, Mistakes, More.
Header: a back link "Home" above a large title "Exam day guide", subtitle "Wednesday, Oct 14".
1. A compact arrival-board style strip: "Arrive 30 minutes early" with the test site name "PSI test center" in secondary ink.
2. Checklist card "What to bring" with 4 rows, each with a round checkbox: "Government photo ID that matches your eAccessNY name", "Silent, nonprinting calculator (no alphabet keys)", "Your exam appointment confirmation", "Nothing else: phones and notes stay in a locker".
3. Section "During the exam": three short rows with small icons (clock "90 minutes, 75 multiple-choice questions", flag "Skip and come back; answer every question", target "Pass mark 70%").
4. Section "Last-hour cram": three tappable rows with route bullets linking to cram sheets: License law numbers, Agency disclosure, Math formulas.
5. Section "After you pass": a vertical subway line with 3 stations: "Results on screen", "Sponsoring broker applies in eAccessNY", "License issued".
Floating tab bar with Home active.
